steps.title: Load destination plates
steps.instruction: Place up to seven destination plates on the deck in order of lowest to highest plate number.

steps.title: Add water to source plate
steps.instruction: Aspirate 8.5 µL of water and dispense it into well A1 of the source barcode plate.

steps.title: Mix water in source well
steps.instruction: Mix the contents of well A1 three times using a 14 µL volume.

steps.title: Transfer to destination plates
steps.instruction: Perform a single 2 µL aspiration from well A1 of the source plate and dispense the 2 µL into well A1 of each destination plate (up to the number of plates selected).

steps.title: Repeat for all columns
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 2–4 for each subsequent column of the source plate (column‑to‑column transfer).
